central_idea: A missed bus becomes a concrete choice through legible example travel times.
cinematic_language: Night street realism, warm practical lamps and cool ambient light; retain Jisu's identity and physical choice without extra drama.
diagram_language: Quiet dark field, warm walking and cool cycling marks on one zero-based scale; keep geometry editable and labels neutral.
source_treatment: Keep original evidence pixels and complete framing; place honest date and attribution on an opaque shared surface, never recolor the source.
